card.name: Cardiovascular outcome phrases in trial results
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases naming cardiovascular events or trial outcomes, such as 'serious CV', 'primary outcome' and 'major adverse cardiovascular events'. Seen in drug-label text on NSAID or fenofibrate cardiovascular risk.
